integrity: Original mathematical proof and a standalone reproducibility checker; no independent audit or formal certification. Comparative November 17 paper is published after the originating June 2026 paper.
scientific_limitations: Independent Gaussian microscopic payoffs, including within-population comparisons; counts all replicator stationary states, not only Nash equilibria. No basin geometry, global convergence or empirical inference. Temporal noise, self-loop-free network games and other payoff distributions excluded. Historical priority is limited by available source text and supplement access.
title: Maximal face-equilibrium probability and stable-state law in Gaussian coupled replicators
